findings.detail: The 2025 SOI localizes the non-accrual classification to two American Academy Holdings, LLC rows marked (17), while the filing also reports a current-period non-accrual category.

rationale: The current-period SOI has two American Academy Holdings, LLC rows carrying footnote marker (17), and the same filing reports a December 31, 2025 non-accrual category of 5,570 / 0.29%. This supports the nonaccrual flag as a real source-backed classification issue rather than a false alarm. The footnote definition text itself was not exposed by the evidence CLI, so confidence is below perfect, but the issuer rows and filing-level non-accrual category ground the classification.
